verdict.rationale: Apify's docs say users can discover and use Actors with AI agents and LLMs through the Apify MCP server, and a probe confirms an official MCP server page at docs.apify.com/platform/integrations/mcp. This clearly delivers the core of the story, but the pack gives only a one-line description and no setup or usage detail. Missing for 10: details on connection setup, transport, authentication and exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
